overall: The AG resolved the complaint by informal action and found no Open Meeting Law violation: the Board produced the minutes, and website posting is not legally required, so that allegation was not reviewed.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the Board failed to create and approve meeting minutes, pointing to a vacant section of a municipal website.
allegations.key_passage: It is therefore clear that the Board did not violate the Open Meeting Law with respect to this allegation.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the Board failed to post meeting minutes to the municipal website.
allegations.key_passage: The Open Meeting Law does not require public bodies to post minutes to a website.
